output.headline: Growth equity investor with 9 of 14 deals in provider services and a 16.5x median price paid, able to fund this Midwest target.
output.differentiator: Its median multiple paid of 16.5x is above the comparable 75th percentile of 15.3x, and 9 of 14 deals are in provider services [V:comps, A:angles].
output.why_them: Provider-focused growth equity; pays upper-quartile multiples

acquirer_overview.title: A growth equity firm with a six-year, provider-weighted record
points: Growth equity firm investing across Technology, Consumer, Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences; AUM US$125.3 billion per its infobox [P:1, P:2].
14 deals from 2019 to 2024, 13 closed (93%), all control deals; 4 since 2022 [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share, K:recent].
9 of 14 deals are in provider services, while 5 sit outside provider services [A:angles, T:record].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Provider specialist with size fit, but no open platform
points: Its closing record and deals in neighbouring sub-sectors are modest factors for; deal size not below its usual range is a slight factor for [S:close_rate_s, S:sector_rel, S:not_smaller].
Its motives stand out in Scale (5 of 14 deals vs 23% of all deals in the file) and Market Share (5 of 14 vs 19%) [M:scale, M:market_share].
Sponsor angles are provider specialist and size fit; it ranks sixth on the priority list of 10 at a 4.5% likelihood [A:angles, R:rank].

precedent_activity.title: Closest precedents: Oak Health in-sector, Crest and Harbor in adjacent provider niches
points: Oak Health (Healthcare Services, $1,708M, Merger of Equals, 2021) was bought at 18.8x EBITDA and closed [D:MA-2021-0066].
Crest Medical Practice (Physician Groups, $121M, Leveraged Buyout, 2023) was bought at 11.5x EBITDA and closed [D:MA-2023-0499].
Harbor Home Health Partners (Midwest, $15M, 2022) was bought at 16.9x; Frontier Clinics ($7M, 2021) was terminated [D:MA-2022-0273, D:MA-2021-0337].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; return at the ask falls short
points: 70 comparable deals of $100M-$400M: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Target margin of 16.8% vs comparables' median of 12.9% supports the 75th percentile; General Atlantic's median paid is 16.5x [X:target, V:comps].
Equity cheque of $128M at 5.0x leverage; IRR at ask 18.7% vs 20% target; maximum price $193M at same exit, $216M at platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M, against $193M at the same exit [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: With no open platform, the platform exit must be underwritten, not assumed [A:angles, V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Thin record in the target's own sub-sector
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector; its share of deals there is a slight factor against [T:record, S:sector_share].
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 deals in adjacent provider sub-sectors, including 4 in Physician Groups [T:record, K:by_sub_sector].
risk_flags.reality: The one in-sector deal was a $1,708M merger, far larger than this target [D:MA-2021-0066].

risk_flags.title: Size and region depth
risk_flags.concern: Only 3 of 14 deals fall in the $100M-$400M band and 2 in the Midwest [K:size_band, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Its median deal of $158M sits within that band [T:record, V:comps].
risk_flags.reality: Crest ($121M, 2023) and Harbor (Midwest, 2022) show execution near this profile [D:MA-2023-0499, D:MA-2022-0273].

conviction.rationale: One deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the fit, but there is no open platform in the sub-sector, which leaves the add-on case neutral [C:conviction, A:angles].
